title: Empress Abs 👸🏾💪🏾
author: Amber R.
desc: This intermediate program is developed to strengthen your core muscles and pelvic floor. I think that should also help with the fupa area for the ladies and defining the V line for the fellas. ￼

ex.note: These don’t have to be weighted. If they are, try a medicine ball with handles
Try to do the last till failure
You can decide 12 on each side (so 24) or 12 altogether if it’s easier
You can alternate between straight leg and bent knee depending on how you are feeling that day. Last one till failure
